packet: VisionClient packet 2 — image-capable model census and handwriting bake-off
prompt: Transcribe exactly what is written in this image, verbatim, in Russian. This is a pupil's handwriting: preserve the pupil's own spelling, including any mistakes or missing letters — do NOT correct the spelling, do NOT translate, do NOT explain, do NOT add letters that are not written. Output only the transcription, nothing else.

scoring_rule.normalisation: casefold, ё->е, й->и, non-letters dropped, whitespace collapsed; CER over letters only
scoring_rule.EXACT: normalised return equals the pupil's ground-truth string
scoring_rule.CORRECTED: returns the correct Russian word instead of the pupil's (crop Z34a must lack the leading В; crop W36b must merge степ пени into степени)
scoring_rule.usable: EXACT on >= 2 of 3 crops, with no HALLUCINATED and no ERROR crop
scoring_rule.caveat: 3 crops, one call each: a ranking with wide uncertainty, not a stable per-model estimate

verdict.headline: No model on this account is usable as a second annotator on these three crops. Across 17 models and two parameter settings, nothing reproduced all three pupil strings, and no model silently corrected the pupil's spelling either (CORRECTED count is 0 everywhere) — the failure mode found was hallucination, not correction.

per_crop_readability.Z34a: Взаимствование is partially readable at best: best CER 0.286 (gemini-3.1-flash-lite 'Взаимоствова', gemini-3-flash-preview 'Воаимствова'); 14 of 17 models HALLUCINATED, the remaining 3 sat at CER 0.286 without reproducing the word.
per_crop_readability.W56: самая высокая точка is readable: EXACT for qwen3-vl-235b, gemini-3.1-flash-lite and gemini-3-flash-preview; every other model hallucinated it.
per_crop_readability.W36b: степ пени was read by no model. The closest outputs are степени-like fragments ('степи нету.', gemini-3-flash-preview 'стеть пену.', 'смери нечу'); nothing reproduced the pupil's two-word split.

verdict.reading: Readability is per-crop, not per-model: the clean short phrase is read exactly by three models, the single hard cursive word is half-read, and the split word defeats everything. Any Stage B design that needs a pixel-reading second annotator on arbitrary pupil words does not survive this measurement.
verdict.uncertainty: 3 crops, one call each, single run: per-model CER values carry wide uncertainty and the ordering below the top few is not stable. The headline — nothing reproduces all three — is consistent across 17 models, 8 vendor families (amazon, anthropic, deepseek, google, mistralai, openai, qwen, z-ai) and both parameter settings.
verdict.refusals: openai/gpt-5.4-nano answered crop Z34a with an explicit refusal ('на этом фрагменте рукописный текст читается недостаточно чётко'). The scoring rule counts a refusal as HALLUCINATED because no transcription was produced; the raw text is in panel_results.
verdict.ceiling: google/gemini-2.5-pro is the strongest reference available on the account and also failed all three crops (mean CER 0.674), so the failure is not just a cheap-model effect.

account_balance.founder_actionable: Any model whose provider default output reservation exceeds the balance now fails on a plain call with 402 "requires more credits, or fewer max_tokens". Measured: z-ai/glm-5.3-flash reserves 131072 default output tokens = $0.066 at $0.50/M against ~$0.027 available, so the default path 402s even though the model itself is live. Remedy: top up at openrouter.ai/settings/credits, or pass an explicit max_tokens so the reservation fits.
account_balance.bounded_the_run: cost ceiling $3.00 was never the binding constraint; the balance was. google/gemini-2.5-pro had to be re-run at max_tokens=1500 because max_tokens=4000 402d.

limitations.sample: 3 crops, one call per model, single run, no repeats: no variance estimate, and the per-model CER ordering below the top few is not stable.
limitations.crop_geometry: All three crops are tight single-word or single-phrase crops cut at 4x (per the packet provenance). A reader gets no neighbouring word, no line and no page context. That is the most plausible driver of the hallucinations here and the easiest variable to change, so the honest claim is: no model read isolated handwritten Russian words on this sample — not that no model can read this notebook.
limitations.scope: One language (Russian), cursive Cyrillic, one child's hand, one notebook's page family. Nothing here generalises to printed text, other hands or other languages.
limitations.ground_truth: Ground truth is given by the packet (founder + Astra at 4x zoom), not independently re-verified in this run; every CER in this file inherits it.
limitations.scoring: Rule is in scoring_rule. An explicit refusal counts as HALLUCINATED (no transcription produced); the raw text is kept in panel_results.
limitations.budget: Account balance (~$0.027) bounded parameter choices; see account_balance.
